PD-LAND-WITHDRAWAL.family: Public land withdrawals and reserves (general, mineral, power-site, public water, stock driveway)

PD-REFUGE-LIGHTHOUSE.family: Bird and wildlife refuges and lighthouse reservations

PD-NATIONAL-FOREST.family: National forest boundary, consolidation and transfer orders

PD-CS-ONE-PERSON.family: One-person civil service orders (waivers, retirement exemptions, designations of named persons)

PD-CS-RULES.family: Amendments of the Civil Service Rules

PD-WAR-EMERGENCY.family: War and emergency orders (WWI emergency, alien property sales, labor-hours suspensions, defensive sea areas)

PD-CUSTOMS-CONSULAR.family: Customs, tariff and consular/foreign service orders

PD-ADMIN.family: Administrative orders (organization, regulations, pay, fund allotments, territories, property transfers, own-terms expiry, tax return inspection, closings)

PD-CLASS-EVENTS.family: Orders ended by a class-wide event (Canal Zone, NRA codes, Philippines)
